definition_en: A person who has had long experience in a specific field or activity.
example_en: She is a veteran of the advertising industry with twenty years experience.
example_uz: U yigirma yillik tajribaga ega reklama sohasi faxriysi.

definition_en: Formal discussions between people who are trying to reach an agreement.
example_en: The peace negotiations lasted for several weeks without a clear result.
example_uz: Tinchlik muzokaralari aniq bir natijasiz bir necha hafta davom etdi.

definition_en: Accepting things as they are and not expecting impossible goals.
example_en: We need to set a realistic budget for our upcoming summer holiday.
example_uz: Yozgi ta'tilimiz uchun real byudjet belgilab olishimiz kerak.

definition_en: To present someone or something in a way that highlights their good qualities.
example_en: The event will showcase the talents of many young local artists.
example_uz: Tadbir ko'plab yosh mahalliy san'atkorlarning iqtidorini namoyish etadi.

definition_en: To become calm and stop worrying or working hard.
example_en: I usually relax by listening to some quiet music in the evening.
example_uz: Men odatda kechqurun sokin musiqa eshitib hordiq chiqaraman.

definition_en: Relating to a formal meeting or a legislative body of a country.
example_en: The committee is currently reviewing the latest congressional report on healthcare.
example_uz: Qoʻmita hozirda sogʻliqni saqlash boʻyicha eng soʻnggi parlament hisobotini koʻrib chiqmoqda.

definition_en: A short summary that gives the main points of a story or report.
example_en: Please provide a brief synopsis of your research project by tomorrow morning.
example_uz: Iltimos, ertaga tonggacha tadqiqot loyihangizning qisqacha mazmunini taqdim eting.

definition_en: Used to say that something is almost not true or very unlikely.
example_en: I could hardly hear what she was saying because of the noise.
example_uz: Shovqin tufayli uning nima deyayotganini deyarli eshita olmadim.

definition_en: A wide area of flat land covered mostly with grass.
example_en: The wild horses ran freely across the vast prairie during the summer.
example_uz: Yovvoyi otlar yoz davomida keng dasht boʻylab erkin yugurishdi.

definition_en: A social event for people who have not seen each other for a long time.
example_en: It was great to see everyone at the high school class reunion.
example_uz: Oʻrta maktabdagi sinfdoshlar uchrashuvida barchani koʻrish juda ajoyib boʻldi.

definition_en: A person who writes music.
example_en: Beethoven is a famous composer who wrote many wonderful symphonies.
example_uz: Betxoven ko'plab ajoyib simfoniyalar yozgan mashhur bastakordir.

definition_en: A seed or pod from a plant that is eaten as a vegetable.
example_en: My mother often adds green beans to our vegetable soup.
example_uz: Onam ko'pincha sabzavotli sho'rvamizga yashil loviya qo'shadi.

definition_en: A long metal weapon with a handle and a sharp blade.
example_en: The knight drew his sword to protect the king from danger.
example_uz: Ritsar qirolni xavfdan himoya qilish uchun qilichini qinidan chiqardi.

definition_en: Not being in a place where you are expected to be.
example_en: He was absent from school yesterday because he had a high fever.
example_uz: U kecha yuqori isitmasi bo'lgani uchun maktabga kelmadi.

definition_en: Relating to or used in the process of making photographs.
example_en: The museum displays old photographic equipment from the last century.
example_uz: Muzeyda o'tgan asrga oid eski fotografiya jihozlari namoyish etilgan.

definition_en: A hard, colorful substance found in the ocean, often used as jewelry.
example_en: Divers love to explore the colorful coral reefs in the ocean.
example_uz: G'avvoslar okeandagi rang-barang marjon riflarini o'rganishni yaxshi ko'radilar.

definition_en: The smallest single point or dot in a digital image.
example_en: High-definition screens contain millions of tiny pixels to show clear images.
example_uz: Yuqori sifatli ekranlar tiniq tasvirni ko'rsatish uchun millionlab mayda piksellardan iborat.

definition_en: To stay on the surface of a liquid without sinking.
example_en: You can watch the wooden leaves float down the quiet river stream.
example_uz: Sen daraxt barglarining sokin daryoda qalqib oqayotganini kuzatishing mumkin.

definition_en: A small ball of air or gas inside a liquid or solid.
example_en: Small soap bubbles floated in the air after the children played outside.
example_uz: Bolalar tashqarida o'ynaganidan so'ng havoda mayda sovun pufaklari qalqib yurardi.

definition_en: A period of time that lasts for one thousand years.
example_en: The celebration marked the end of a long and historic millennium.
example_uz: Bayram uzoq va tarixiy ming yillikning yakunlanganini nishonladi.

definition_en: A person who defends the rights and interests of common people.
example_en: He acted as a tribune for the workers during the intense strike.
example_uz: U keskin ish tashlash paytida ishchilarning manfaatlarini himoya qiluvchi shaxs sifatida harakat qildi.

definition_en: A large boat or ship designed for travel on the water.
example_en: The large cargo vessel sailed slowly across the deep blue ocean.
example_uz: Katta yuk kemasi chuqur ko'k okean bo'ylab sekin suzib o'tdi.

definition_en: Costing less money than another thing you are comparing it to.
example_en: This blue shirt is much cheaper than the one I saw yesterday.
example_uz: Bu ko'k ko'ylak kecha men ko'rganimdan ancha arzonroq.

definition_en: To agree that something is true, especially when you are unwilling to do so.
example_en: He admitted that he had made a mistake during the project meeting.
example_uz: U loyiha yig'ilishida xato qilganini tan oldi.

definition_en: Foods made from the milk of animals, such as butter, cheese, and yogurt.
example_en: The doctor advised me to eat more healthy dairy products every day.
example_uz: Shifokor menga har kuni sog'lom sut mahsulotlarini ko'proq iste'mol qilishni maslahat berdi.

definition_en: Expensive or decorative in a way that is meant to impress other people.
example_en: We went to a very fancy restaurant for our wedding anniversary dinner.
example_uz: To'y yilligimiz munosabati bilan juda hashamatli restoranga bordik.

definition_en: The state of having the same rights, status, and opportunities as everyone else.
example_en: Social equality is important for a fair and peaceful society to exist.
example_uz: Adolatli va tinch jamiyat mavjud bo'lishi uchun ijtimoiy tenglik muhim ahamiyatga ega.

definition_en: A device used to control the flow of water from a pipe.
example_en: Please turn off the kitchen tap tightly to save water every day.
example_uz: Suvni tejash uchun iltimos oshxonadagi jo'mrakni mahkam yopib qo'ying.

definition_en: Small pieces of paper with a sticky back for attaching to surfaces as decoration.
example_en: The teacher gave the students colorful stickers for their excellent homework performance.
example_uz: O'qituvchi uyga vazifani a'lo bajargan o'quvchilarga rangli stikerlar berdi.

definition_en: Areas or businesses that are involved in catching or farming fish.
example_en: The government is trying to protect local fisheries from overfishing.
example_uz: Hukumat mahalliy baliqchilik xo'jaliklarini ortiqcha ovlashdan himoya qilishga urinmoqda.

definition_en: A person or animal you spend a lot of time with.
example_en: His dog has been his trusted companion for the last five years.
example_uz: Iti besh yildan buyon uning sodiq hamrohi bo'lib kelmoqda.

definition_en: A small group of people organized for a specific task.
example_en: He assembled a squad of ten to take on the difficult task.
example_uz: U murakkab topshiriqni bajarish uchun o'n kishilik guruh tuzdi.

definition_en: To look at something carefully to understand how it works.
example_en: Scientists need to analyze the data before drawing any conclusions.
example_uz: Olimlar xulosa chiqarishdan oldin ma'lumotlarni tahlil qilishlari kerak.

definition_en: To move text or images up or down on a computer screen.
example_en: She kept scrolling until she found the desired paragraph.
example_uz: U kerakli xatboshini topmaguncha ekranni aylantirishda davom etdi.

definition_en: To show or have a connection between two or more things.
example_en: The patterns on the screen relate to the volume of the music.
example_uz: Ekrandagi tasvirlar musiqa balandligiga bog'liq.

definition_en: Used to add more information to what has already been said.
example_en: Additionally, the company decided to hire five new office workers.
example_uz: Bundan tashqari kompaniya beshta yangi xodim yollashga qaror qildi.

definition_en: To experience something painful, difficult, or unpleasant.
example_en: Many people suffer from headaches when they work too long.
example_uz: Ko'p odamlar uzoq ishlaganda bosh og'rig'idan qiynalishadi.

definition_en: A friendly feeling that exists between people who share a common purpose.
example_en: The club members enjoyed a sense of fellowship during their meetings.
example_uz: Klub a'zolari uchrashuvlarda o'zaro do'stlik tuyg'usini his qilishdi.

definition_en: Relating to extremely small objects or pieces of technology.
example_en: Scientists are developing nano robots to help repair damaged human cells.
example_uz: Olimlar zararlangan hujayralarni tiklash uchun nano robotlar ustida ishlamoqda.

definition_en: Not legally or factually correct and therefore not acceptable.
example_en: The travel document was invalid because it had already expired.
example_uz: Sayohat hujjati yaroqsiz edi chunki uning muddati o'tib bo'lgan.

definition_en: Relating to soldiers, fighting, or war.
example_en: He studied martial arts for many years to learn self-defense.
example_uz: U o'zini himoya qilishni o'rganish uchun ko'p yillar jang san'ati bilan shug'ullandi.

definition_en: A long passage built underground or through a mountain for traffic.
example_en: The train passed quickly through the dark tunnel under the mountain.
example_uz: Poyezd tog' ostidagi qorong'u tunneldan tezda o'tib ketdi.

definition_en: A country located in Southeast Asia, known for the ancient Angkor Wat temple.
example_en: Many tourists visit Cambodia every year to see the historical temples.
example_uz: Ko'plab sayyohlar har yili tarixiy ibodatxonalarni ko'rish uchun Kambodjaga borishadi.

definition_en: A situation where everything is confused and in a total mess.
example_en: After the earthquake, the city center was in complete and utter chaos.
example_uz: Zilziladan so'ng shahar markazida mutlaq tartibsizlik hukm surdi.

definition_en: A country in Northern Europe, the largest of the three Baltic states.
example_en: The capital city of Lithuania is Vilnius, which has a beautiful old town.
example_uz: Litvaning poytaxti — go'zal eski shaharga ega Vilnyus shahri.

definition_en: A large international company that provides credit and debit card payment services.
example_en: You can pay for your flight online using your Visa or Mastercard.
example_uz: Aviachipta uchun Visa yoki Mastercard kartangiz orqali onlayn to'lashingiz mumkin.

definition_en: A cereal grain used to make flour for bread, pasta, and pastries.
example_en: Farmers usually harvest the wheat during the hot summer months.
example_uz: Dehqonlar odatda bug'doyni issiq yoz oylarida o'rib olishadi.

definition_en: Books or records that tell the history of events in the order they happened.
example_en: The ancient chronicles describe the lives of kings from many centuries ago.
example_uz: Qadimgi yilnomalarda ko'p asrlar oldingi shohlarning hayoti tasvirlangan.

definition_en: A furry animal with a flat tail that builds dams in rivers.
example_en: The industrious beaver uses branches to build a strong dam in the river.
example_uz: Mehnatsevar qunduz daryoda mustahkam to'g'on qurish uchun shoxlardan foydalanadi.

definition_en: The numbers or amounts shown on a device or measuring instrument.
example_en: The current thermometer readings indicate that the room is getting quite warm.
example_uz: Termometr ko'rsatkichlari xona ancha isib borayotganini ko'rsatmoqda.

definition_en: Made to look beautiful rather than for practical use.
example_en: She placed some decorative pillows on the sofa to brighten the room.
example_uz: U xonani yoritish uchun divanga bezakli yostiqchalar qo'ydi.

definition_en: A computer program that translates written code into a language the machine understands.
example_en: The developer used a new compiler to improve the software's overall performance.
example_uz: Dasturchi dasturiy ta'minot ishini yaxshilash uchun yangi kompilyatordan foydalandi.

definition_en: The process of making something bigger in size or scale.
example_en: The plans for the park include an enlargement of the playground area.
example_uz: Bog'ni loyihalash rejalariga o'yin maydonchasini kengaytirish ham kiradi.

definition_en: A person who is officially charged with committing a crime.
example_en: The accused was brought into the courtroom to hear the final verdict.
example_uz: Ayblanuvchini yakuniy hukmni eshitish uchun sud zaliga olib kirishdi.

definition_en: A flying insect that makes honey and can sting.
example_en: A busy bee was collecting pollen from the flowers in the garden.
example_uz: Mehnatkash asalari bog'dagi gullardan gulchangi yig'ayotgan edi.

definition_en: The state of being joined together as a single, undivided whole.
example_en: The national unity of the country is based on shared cultural values.
example_uz: Mamlakatning milliy birligi umumiy madaniy qadriyatlarga asoslanadi.

definition_en: Making a strong sound that is easily heard.
example_en: Please turn the music down because it is too loud here.
example_uz: Iltimos, musiqani pasaytiring, chunki bu yerda juda shovqin bo'lyapti.

definition_en: A word used to connect words, phrases, or clauses in a sentence.
example_en: The words and, but, and or are common conjunctions in English.
example_uz: Ingliz tilida 'and', 'but' va 'or' so'zlari eng ko'p ishlatiladigan bog'lovchilardir.

definition_en: A woman on her wedding day or just after she is married.
example_en: The bride looked beautiful in her white wedding dress today.
example_uz: Kelin bugun oq to'y libosida juda go'zal ko'rindi.

definition_en: The past participle form of the verb begin.
example_en: They have already begun their work on the new office project.
example_uz: Ular yangi ofis loyihasi ustidagi ishni allaqachon boshlashgan.

definition_en: A woman or girl who has brown hair.
example_en: She is a tall brunette who works at the local library.
example_uz: U mahalliy kutubxonada ishlaydigan bo'yi baland, jigarrang sochli ayoldir.

definition_en: A heavy metal object used to hold a boat in one place.
example_en: The captain decided to drop the anchor near the small island.
example_uz: Kapitan kichik orol yaqinida langar tashlashga qaror qildi.

definition_en: The act of showing that something is true, correct, or officially accepted.
example_en: She felt that she needed more validation from her supportive team members.
example_uz: U o'z jamoasidan ko'proq ma'qullash olishni his etdi.

definition_en: A public celebration where many people move through the streets, often with music.
example_en: Thousands of people gathered in the city center for the annual parade.
example_uz: Har yili o'tkaziladigan paradni tomosha qilish uchun shahar markaziga minglab odamlar yig'ildi.

definition_en: Dishonest or illegal behavior, especially by people who have authority or power.
example_en: The government is working hard to eliminate corruption in all public departments.
example_uz: Hukumat barcha davlat idoralarida korrupsiyani yo'q qilish ustida qattiq ishlamoqda.

definition_en: Done immediately, without any delay at all.
example_en: The doctor ordered the laboratory to run the patient's blood test stat.
example_uz: Shifokor laboratoriyaga bemorning qon tahlilini zudlik bilan o'tkazishni buyurdi.

definition_en: A fatty substance found in the body that can cause heart disease.
example_en: Eating a healthy diet helps to keep your cholesterol at low levels.
example_uz: Sog'lom ovqatlanish xolesterin darajasini past saqlashga yordam beradi.

definition_en: Came together in one place to form a group or collect items.
example_en: The students gathered around the teacher to hear about the new project.
example_uz: O'quvchilar yangi loyiha haqida eshitish uchun o'qituvchi atrofida to'planishdi.

definition_en: A specific difference in amount or value between two things that are compared.
example_en: The wage differential between the two groups of workers is quite significant.
example_uz: Bu ikki ishchi guruhi o'rtasidagi ish haqi farqi anchagina katta.

definition_en: A piece of jewellery that hangs on a chain worn around the neck.
example_en: She wore a gold pendant that had belonged to her grandmother.
example_uz: U buvisidan qolgan tilla kulonni taqib yurardi.

definition_en: A person who studies or works in science using research and experiments.
example_en: The scientist spent years researching the effects of climate change on oceans.
example_uz: Olim iqlim o'zgarishining okeanlarga ta'sirini o'rganishga ko'p yillar sarfladi.

definition_en: A medical condition that causes pain, swelling, and stiffness in the body's joints.
example_en: My grandfather suffers from severe arthritis in his hands and knees.
example_uz: Bobomning qo'l va tizzalarida qattiq artrit bor.

definition_en: In spite of what has just been mentioned.
example_en: The weather was cold; nevertheless, we decided to go for a walk.
example_uz: Ob-havo sovuq edi, shunga qaramay sayrga chiqishga qaror qildik.

definition_en: The system of requiring people or companies to pay money to the government.
example_en: The government is planning to reform the current system of business taxation.
example_uz: Hukumat amaldagi biznes soliq tizimini isloh qilishni rejalashtirmoqda.

definition_en: A particular style of cooking, usually associated with a specific country or region.
example_en: The restaurant is well known for its authentic traditional Uzbek cuisine.
example_uz: Bu restoran o‘zining haqiqiy milliy o‘zbek taomlari bilan mashhur.

definition_en: Used to express that you are very confident about what you are saying.
example_en: Surely there must be a better way to solve this difficult problem.
example_uz: Bu qiyin muammoni hal qilishning shubhasiz yaxshiroq yo‘li bordir.

definition_en: A written copy of words that were originally spoken out loud.
example_en: The journalist published a full transcript of the interview on the website.
example_uz: Jurnalist intervyuning to‘liq matnini veb-saytda e’lon qildi.

definition_en: A mathematical statement that has been proven to be true using logic and rules.
example_en: The student spent all afternoon trying to prove the complex geometric theorem.
example_uz: O‘quvchi butun tushdan keyin murakkab geometrik teoremani isbotlashga harakat qildi.

definition_en: To speak to God to show respect or to ask for help.
example_en: Every morning, the family gathers together to pray for peace and health.
example_uz: Har kuni ertalab oila tinchlik va sog‘lik so‘rab duo qilish uchun yig‘iladi.

definition_en: A small, pen-shaped tool used for writing or drawing on touch screens.
example_en: I use a stylus to take notes and draw pictures on my tablet.
example_uz: Men planshetimda eslatmalar yozish va rasm chizish uchun stilusdan foydalanaman.

definition_en: The leader of the Roman Catholic Church, who lives in Vatican City.
example_en: The Pope addressed thousands of people gathered at St. Peter's Square today.
example_uz: Bugun Rim papasi Avliyo Pyotr maydonida to‘plangan minglab odamlar oldida nutq so‘zladi.

definition_en: To a fair or satisfactory degree, but not extremely.
example_en: The hotel was reasonably priced and located near the city centre.
example_uz: Mehmonxona narxi maqbul edi va u shahar markaziga yaqin joylashgan edi.

definition_en: A strong car made for driving on difficult ground like mud or sand.
example_en: They drove their jeep across the mountains to reach the remote village.
example_uz: Ular tog'li qishloqqa yetib borish uchun tog'lardan yo'ltanlamas avtomobilida o'tishdi.

definition_en: Not covered by any clothing or things; empty.
example_en: The trees were bare because it was the middle of winter.
example_uz: Qish o'rtasi bo'lgani uchun daraxtlar yalang'och edi.

definition_en: The past form of hang; held from above so the bottom does not touch ground.
example_en: She hung her wet coat on the hook by the front door.
example_uz: U ho'l paltosini kirish eshigi yonidagi ilmoqqa ilib qo'ydi.

definition_en: Large farm animals kept for their milk or meat, such as cows and bulls.
example_en: The farmer takes his cattle to the field early every morning.
example_uz: Fermer har kuni erta tongda chorva mollarini dalaga haydaydi.

definition_en: A person who likes to travel or move around to many different places.
example_en: He has been a constant rover, visiting almost every country in the world.
example_uz: U dunyodagi deyarli barcha mamlakatlarni kezib chiqqan haqiqiy sayohatchi.

definition_en: Wanting to have power over other people and tell them what to do.
example_en: It is difficult to work with a boss who is very controlling.
example_uz: O'z bilganicha ish qiladigan rahbar bilan ishlash juda qiyin.

definition_en: To consider someone or something to be very precious and valuable.
example_en: Oh, this ring is beautiful! I will treasure it forever.
example_uz: Bu uzuk juda chiroyli! Men uni umrbod qadrlayman.

definition_en: To put a new supply of something, like bullets or data, into a machine.
example_en: He had to reload his weapon before he could continue the practice.
example_uz: Mashg'ulotni davom ettirish uchun u qurolini qayta o'qlashi kerak edi.

definition_en: The hot, bright, moving light that is produced by something that is burning.
example_en: The candle began to flicker as a small flame danced on top.
example_uz: Sham ustida kichik olov raqsga tushgandek miltillay boshladi.

definition_en: Relating to the money used in a country or to the economy.
example_en: The country is facing serious monetary issues due to the high inflation.
example_uz: Mamlakat yuqori inflyatsiya tufayli jiddiy moliyaviy muammolarga duch kelmoqda.

definition_en: Used as a polite way to describe a person who is old.
example_en: We should always show respect to the elderly in our community.
example_uz: Biz har doim jamiyatimizdagi keksalarimizga hurmat ko'rsatishimiz kerak.

definition_en: A deep hole in the ground, often made by digging.
example_en: The workmen dug a large pit to install the new water pipes.
example_uz: Ishchilar yangi suv quvurlarini o'rnatish uchun katta chuqur qazishdi.

definition_en: Very unusual, special, or much better than what is normal.
example_en: The team achieved an extraordinary result in the final football match.
example_uz: Jamoa final o'yinida favqulodda yaxshi natijaga erishdi.

definition_en: A thin, flat piece of baked clay used for covering floors or walls.
example_en: We chose a white marble tile for the new kitchen wall.
example_uz: Oshxonaning yangi devori uchun oq marmar kafel tanladik.

definition_en: To say or write the letters of a word in the correct order.
example_en: Can you spell your name for me, please?
example_uz: Ismingizni harflab aytib bera olasizmi?

definition_en: Having the highest temperature; the most extreme form of hot.
example_en: August is usually the hottest month of the year here.
example_uz: Avgust bu yerda odatda yilning eng issiq oyi hisoblanadi.

definition_en: A number that shows the exact position of a point on a map.
example_en: Please enter the map coordinates into the GPS device.
example_uz: Iltimos, xarita koordinatalarini GPS qurilmasiga kiriting.

definition_en: Only for one specific purpose or group and no one else.
example_en: These new shoes are made exclusively out of high quality leather.
example_uz: Bu yangi poyabzallar faqat sifatli teridan tayyorlangan.

definition_en: A rule or factor that makes something or someone unable to do more.
example_en: He understood the material but his fear was a limitation to success.
example_uz: U mavzuni tushunardi lekin qo'rquvi muvaffaqiyatga erishishiga to'sqinlik qildi.

definition_en: Having a shape that is much wider than it is tall.
example_en: We bought a new widescreen television to watch movies every weekend.
example_uz: Har dam olish kuni kino ko'rish uchun yangi keng ekranli televizor sotib oldik.

definition_en: Past tense of hit; to touch something with force.
example_en: The clock struck twelve just as we arrived at the station.
example_uz: Biz bekatga yetib kelganimizda soat o'n ikkini chaldi.

definition_en: A drawing or picture that shows something or makes it easier to understand.
example_en: The textbook contains a beautiful illustration for every single new lesson.
example_uz: Darslikdagi har bir yangi mavzu uchun chiroyli tasvir berilgan.

definition_en: Statements that tell you about a possible danger or problem.
example_en: We received many warnings about the coming storm on the radio.
example_uz: Radioda yaqinlashib kelayotgan bo'ron haqida ko'plab ogohlantirishlar oldik.

definition_en: To build something, especially a building, structure, or machine.
example_en: The company plans to construct a new bridge over the river.
example_uz: Kompaniya daryo ustiga yangi ko'prik qurishni rejalashtirmoqda.

definition_en: Questions that you ask to get information about something.
example_en: We have received many inquiries about the new products this week.
example_uz: Bu hafta yangi mahsulotlar haqida ko'plab so'rovlar oldik.

definition_en: Related to a bride or a wedding ceremony.
example_en: She went shopping to find the perfect bridal dress for her wedding.
example_uz: U to'yi uchun mukammal kelinlik ko'ylagini izlab do'konlarga bordi.

definition_en: To take control of a country or region and add it to your own.
example_en: History shows that empires often tried to annex neighboring territories by force.
example_uz: Tarix shuni ko'rsatadiki, imperiyalar ko'pincha qo'shni hududlarni kuch bilan qo'shib olishga harakat qilgan.

definition_en: A thin book with stories, news, and pictures, usually published every week or month.
example_en: I read an interesting article about travel in my favorite mag today.
example_uz: Bugun sevimli jurnalimda sayohat haqida qiziqarli maqola o'qidim.

definition_en: A sudden feeling of enthusiasm or a new idea that helps you create something.

example_uz: U poyezdga chiqishdan oldin qo'l siltab xayr deb baqirdi.

definition_en: A person or company whose job is to take packages or messages somewhere.

example_uz: Men muhim hujjatlarni ofisga xususiy kuryer orqali yubordim.

definition_en: Small pieces of information that suggest something or help you understand a situation.

example_uz: Ular klubda tun bo'yi baland texno musiqasiga raqs tushishdi.

definition_en: Any type of liquid that you can drink, usually other than water.

definition_en: Not happening often; very seldom.

example_uz: Biz kinoteatrga kamdan-kam boramiz, chunki uyda kino ko'rishni afzal ko'ramiz.

definition_en: The origin or beginning of something.

example_uz: Ko'plab tarixchilar Britaniyada sanoat inqilobining boshlanishini o'rganishadi.

definition_en: The amount of water vapor that is present in the air.

definition_en: A new period of growth or activity for something that was not popular.

example_uz: An’anaviy xalq musiqasining ommaviyligi qayta tiklanmoqda.

definition_en: A physical or mental condition that is not normal or healthy.

definition_en: The scientific study of human society, relationships, and how people interact.
example_en: She decided to study sociology to understand modern social problems better.
example_uz: U zamonaviy ijtimoiy muammolarni yaxshiroq tushunish uchun sosiologiyani o‘rganishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: A digital image of what is visible on a computer or phone screen.
example_en: I took a screenshot of the error message to send to support.
example_uz: Xatolik haqidagi xabarni qo‘llab-quvvatlash markaziga yuborish uchun ekran tasvirini oldim.
